description: Elections Commission - Declare that T. Sritharan as a member of the Valvettithurai Urban Council
reasoning: This gazette concerns the filling of a vacancy in a local government council (Valvettithurai Urban Council) due to a resignation, which is a matter directly related to electoral processes under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It involves the nomination and declaration of a new council member by a political party, falling squarely within the scope of election-related administrative matters.
